title: PDF 電子收據生成 + SES 郵件發送 (後端)
content: 後端部分：實作 @react-pdf/renderer 收據模板（三語）、PDF 密碼保護（pdf-lib-encrypt AES-256，使用 idDocNumber 首 6 位數字）、SES 郵件發送。觸發點為管理員核准報名（PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE）。PDF 即時生成（無 S3 儲存）。

commands: npm run dev → receipt page PDF download verified working
findings: Receipt PDF renders via @react-pdf/renderer v4 with Noto Sans SC (CJK + Latin) — bilingual ZH+EN
PDF password-protected via pdf-lib-encrypt AES-256 using first 6 digits of idDocNumber
Receipt number auto-incrementing: RCPT-YYYY-NNNNN, stored in Registrant.receiptNumber
Triggered on admin PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/{id} APPROVE — generates PDF and updates DB
SES email code exists but untested (requires AWS SES sender verification)
S3 storage removed entirely — PDFs generated on-the-fly from DB data
Shared renderReceiptPdf() in render.tsx used by both download and generation paths
Encryption uses a shared encrypt.ts module to avoid Turbopack double-configuration issues
evidence.residual: SES email untested (sender verification pending in AWS Console). Adobe Acrobat may display a warning because AES-256 encryption is applied by pdf-lib-encrypt rather than native Acrobat — this is cosmetic only.

acceptance: PDF receipt template via @react-pdf/renderer — bilingual ZH+EN, includes LMC letterhead, receipt number, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC stamp
Receipt number format: RCPT-{YYYY}-{NNNNN}, auto-incrementing, stored in Registrant.receiptNumber in DB
PDF generated on-the-fly from DB data — no S3 storage required
PDF password-protected via pdf-lib-encrypt AES-256 with first 6 digits of registrant's idDocNumber
Triggered on admin PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] APPROVE — auto-generate PDF, update DB
SES email via nodemailer: bilingual subject/body (ZH+EN), PDF as attachment, to registrant's email, BCC admin
Error handling: if SES fails, receipt PDF is already in-memory and DB is updated — log failure, do not roll back approval
Shared renderReceiptPdf() used by both generateReceipt (admin approval) and download endpoint (user re-download)
Shared encrypt.ts module to avoid pdf-lib configure() being called multiple times under Turbopack
files: src/lib/receipt/texts.ts (new — hardcoded bilingual strings for receipt PDF)
src/lib/receipt/styles.ts (new — StyleSheet.create + Font registration for Noto Sans SC)
src/lib/receipt/generate.tsx (new — receipt number generator + PDF generation + encryption)
src/lib/receipt/encrypt.ts (new — shared pdf-lib-encrypt configure() + receiptPassword() helper)
src/app/api/download/receipt/route.ts (new — on-the-fly PDF download with password protection)
verification: Admin approves enrolment → receipt number generated in DB with status VERIFIED. PDF on-the-fly from DB. Download via POST /api/download/receipt opens correctly with first 6 digits of idDocNumber. npm run typecheck + npm run lint pass.
